(also written बेह्) cl. 1. Ā. वेहते, to strive, make effort, Dhātup. xvi, 42;
 cl. 1. P. वेहति = वेहाय, Vop.
a barren cow or and cow that miscarries, VS.; AV.; Br. (cf. Uṇ. ii, 85; accord. to L. also ‘a cow that desires the bull’ or ‘a pregnant cow’).
Nom. (fr. prec.) Ā. ˚यते, to miscarry g. भृशादि.
(with Jainas) a partic. forbidden mode of suicide, Śīl.
